title: Expectation by cardinality and subset
statement: For any real-valued function on the subsets of an $n$-element set, its Shapley expectation equals the expectation obtained by first choosing a cardinality uniformly from $0,1,\ldots,n$ and then choosing uniformly among the subsets of that cardinality.
hypotheses_covered: The function is real-valued on its subsets
